name: python-pytest-plugin
title: Python pytest plugin
blurb: A pytest plugin as the product: a registered ticket marker, a duration report written for every phase of every test, a strict mode that refuses a suite with unmarked tests, and a console script that gates on long tests
default_description: A pytest plugin that reports what each test actually cost, with a strict metadata mode and a duration gate.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
